lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Hello! Are you from the Paragon?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Hello, are you the Student Council President?

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Yup! That's me. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Our editorial draft needs the exact list of student demands.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: I want to give them to you, Kiko, but if we don't cite the exact school charter article, Mr. Reyes will dismiss it.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: The old Student Council Constitution Handbook is in the library archives. Can you find it and bring it to me?

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: The library archives have so many records... good luck finding the handbook!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I found the Student Council Constitution Handbook in the archives!

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Perfect! 'Article IV, Section 2: Student funds shall not be diverted without bilateral consent.' Exactly what we need!

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Here is the raw list of demands. But watch out—Mr. Reyes requires strict list formatting on official petitions!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Got it. Time to head back to Mr. Reyes for the guidelines memo and format the editorial.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: We need that charter article from the handbook before we finalize the demands!
